items.summary: The Nevada State Veterans Memorial, 18 larger-than-life bronze statues by sculptor Douwe Blumberg that honor American military service from the Revolutionary War to the present, has a new permanent home in a park setting at Thunderbird Family Sports Complex. The statues were commissioned by the state in 2011 and moved from outside the former Grant Sawyer state office building. The new site adds an open-air promenade with landscaping, an amphitheater and informational signage. The city scheduled a free public unveiling for Veterans Day 2026.
items.whyItMatters: A new public place in northwest Las Vegas that residents, families and visiting veterans can actually go to, inside a park many Centennial Hills/Skye Canyon-area families already use. Answers 'where did the veterans memorial go?' and 'what is new at Thunderbird park?'. Highly visual, public, and not covered by LVINIT.

tomorrowAssignment.workingHeadline: Life Time Durango opens Dec. 14: what's inside the 128,000-square-foot club across from IKEA
tomorrowAssignment.location: 8555 W. Sunset Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89113: the southeast corner of Durango Dr and Sunset Rd, across from IKEA, southwest Las Vegas / Enterprise.
tomorrowAssignment.editorialCategory: Coming soon / Recreation & fitness / Southwest Las Vegas
tomorrowAssignment.whyBest: It's a fresh status change verified on the operator's own page: Life Time switched from 'Arriving Late 2026' to 'Arriving December 14' since the last run. It's one of the biggest new recreation buildings in the southwest valley, it's opening in under four weeks, and LVINIT has no coverage. The finished exterior is visible from public sidewalks, so Mikey can shoot a real hero tomorrow morning. Sloan Junction, the other READY candidate, is a durable explainer and keeps as a fallback.
tomorrowAssignment.whatHappened: Life Time's Durango location page now gives an opening date of Dec 14 for its 128,000 sq ft, 15-acre athletic country club at 8555 W. Sunset Rd, and offers pre-opening membership benefits. Life Time's own September article describes it as the company's 200th club and its third in the Las Vegas area. Features include indoor and outdoor pools with waterslides and 12 cabanas, six indoor pickleball courts, a LifeSpa, a Kids Academy, a third-floor workout floor, recovery zones, a LifeCafe and a Life Time Work coworking space. It fills the long-vacant Durango/Sunset site across from IKEA.
confirmedFacts: Life Time location page (READ 2026-11-20): 'Arriving December 14. Become a member today and receive preopening benefits.'
Address 8555 West Sunset Road, Las Vegas, NV 89113; 128,000 sq ft on 15 acres; phone 725-277-6200 (location page).

Listed amenities (location page): outdoor lap and leisure pool, kids swim, indoor pickleball, indoor cold plunge, wet suite with whirlpool and sauna, reformer Pilates, studio classes, Kids Academy, LifeCafe, LifeSpa, LT Work Lounge, training, recovery and nutrition services.

Life Time 'Step Inside Life Time Durango' (READ; Sept 8, 2026): 200th location; third Life Time athletic country club in the Las Vegas area; six indoor pickleball courts plus a lounge; indoor six-lane lap, six-lane lesson and leisure pools; outdoor leisure pool, six-lane pool, waterslides, 12 cabanas and a bistro; LifeSpa (8 styling stations, 5 treatment rooms); third-floor workout floor; LT Recovery zone; standalone Life Time Work location reached from the second floor; LifeClinic chiropractic (extra cost). Quote from Martin Martinez: 'It's been 12 years since our last grand opening in Las Vegas.'

morningMission.location: 8555 W. Sunset Rd, Las Vegas 89113: the SE corner of Durango Dr and Sunset Rd, across Sunset from IKEA (6500 S. Durango).
morningMission.publicAccess: Public sidewalks on Sunset Rd and Durango Dr. The IKEA parking lot is private retail property; brief photos of the building across the street are generally fine, but leave if staff ask. The club itself isn't open, so don't enter the Life Time lot or building if it's gated or still under construction.
morningMission.timing: Morning (about 7:30-9:30 a.m.). The building is on the south side of Sunset, so from the north side of Sunset (IKEA side) the morning sun comes from the east-southeast and lights the facade at an angle. Late afternoon is an alternative if the main entrance faces west or Durango.
morningMission.heroImage: A wide horizontal shot of the finished Life Time Durango building with its signage, from the north side of Sunset Rd or the Durango/Sunset corner, with the Spring Mountains visible if the angle allows. It should read as 'it's built, it opens Dec 14.'
supportingShots: Close-up of the Life Time signage or logo on the building.
Any 'opening Dec 14' or membership banner visible from public areas.
The outdoor pool deck or waterslide structures if visible over the wall from a public sidewalk. Don't climb or lean over fences.
The main entrance and drop-off from the public sidewalk.
Streetscape: the Durango/Sunset intersection with traffic and the club, to show neighborhood context.
IKEA across the street, as the landmark readers will recognize.
establishingShots: A wide from the Durango and Sunset corner showing the building's scale on its 15-acre site.
If legal and safe, an elevated or drone view. Note: this is near the 215 and under Harry Reid/Class B airspace; check FAA rules and LAANC before flying. Skip the drone if unsure.
doNot: Don't enter the property, parking lot or construction areas before opening without Life Time's permission.
Don't photograph staff or members identifiably without consent.
Don't caption anything as the interior unless it's Mikey's own interior footage taken with permission.
Don't imply LVINIT has a partnership or sponsorship with Life Time.
morningMission.videoOpportunity: Short-form: 'This 128,000-square-foot club across from IKEA opens Dec 14. Here's what's going in.' Long-form later: a 'first look inside' if Life Time grants a media preview before or on Dec 14.
morningMission.permissionNeeded: None for exterior shots from public sidewalks. Interior or on-site filming needs Life Time's permission; the public contact is the club line 725-277-6200. No outreach was sent.
